episodes.synopsis: Orphen is searching for his friend Azalie after she had disappeared five years ago. He’s currently trying to pay off his debt at the inn he’s staying at when two dwarves named Volkan and Dortin tell him they have a sweet plan to get him out of debt.
episodes.title: A Vestige of the Past

episodes.synopsis: Orphen, Volkan, and Dortin are captured by the authorities after the fiasco with the monster that appeared. Orphen is then summoned by Heartia to go talk to his former master, Childman.
episodes.title: The Tower of Fangs

episodes.synopsis: Orphen goes with Childman and the other Black Sorcerers in order to try to track down Azalie before they can kill her. He manages to track down the creature, and despite his best efforts to talk to her, the creature attacks.
episodes.title: Heed My Call, Beast

episodes.synopsis: Orphen remembers more of his past at the Tower of Fangs and a time when he and Azalie ventured back to the orphanage where they grew up. Back in present time, Orphen finds a couple of stowaways…
episodes.title: The Chaos Witch and the Successor of the Razor’s Edge

episodes.synopsis: Orphen, Claiomh, and Majic try to get through Fenrir’s Forest to get to Tafrem. However, Majic ends up lost in the forest and runs into a mysterious girl.
episodes.title: Deep Dragon

episodes.synopsis: After Orphen is attacked by the Deep Dragon, he wakes up in a cell unsure of where he is or who he is for a moment. A girl then appears before him, and offers to heal his wounds and eventually, his memories return.
episodes.title: Forest Maiden

episodes.synopsis: Orphen tries to stop MacDougal from going into the Dragon’s sanctuary. The Deep Dragon attacks the village for attempting to go into the Dragon’s sanctuary and Orphen tries to save the villagers.
episodes.title: Gather In My Forest, Wolves

episodes.synopsis: An assassin is killing one elder after another. Forte and Leticia try to find out who’s behind the murders. Meanwhile, the assassin shows himself before Orphen and he’s shocked to see that they have the same face as him.
episodes.title: An Unexpected Assassin

episodes.synopsis: Leticia and Orphen try to figure out who the assassin actually is. Is Orphen who he thinks he is, or is the assassin calling himself Krylancelo his true self?
episodes.title: Ghost from the Past

episodes.synopsis: Claiomh is kidnapped by the assassin, and Orphen faces off with the assassin that calls himself Krylancelo once and for all in order to save her.
episodes.title: Make My Past Disappear, Assassin

episodes.synopsis: Claiomh tries to cook some food to nurse Orphen back to health, but it might be doing more harm than good. Orphen and Leticia take Majic to the Tower of Fangs so he can enroll.
episodes.title: The Uoar Class

episodes.synopsis: Tish ends up following one of the assassins so that Orphen wouldn’t have to deal with them and ends up getting hurt. Orphen plans to get revenge, but gets help from an unlikely source.
episodes.title: Death Keening

episodes.synopsis: Orphen, Claiomh, and Majic head to the Tower of Fangs to settle things with the Uoar Class once and for all!
episodes.title: Come to My Tower, Successor
